stages.closure: verify receipt equals the stage receipt. The pinned Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 OCI metadata, blobs and offline debs are fetched once into the owned host input root, framed as one fixed finite transfer stream and streamed to the guest through the fixed guest helper, which writes them into {guest_context}.oci and {guest_context}.debs and derives the layout again from the received index, manifest and config. A second guest check re-derives the same layout from disk immediately before the build. Every transfer and remote command step closes only through its authenticated helper envelope. The build is bounded by a 600 second command envelope with a guest deadline of 540 seconds (timeout -k 5), leaving 55 seconds of host receipt margin. Closed needs a waited exit 0 and an iidfile ID that inspects as linux/arm64. The build argv is --network none with the two additional local contexts; FROM cannot contact a registry. C5 needs this closure and the identity check.
stages.failure: no retry. A missing, extra, duplicate, partial, overrun, replaced or mis-hashed input, a stream or guest receipt mismatch, a timeout, a deadline or a non-zero build exit is Unknown and retained and never reaches C5. The host input root, the framed stream, the guest context directory and the guest input directories are retained exactly as they are, never adopted, re-pinned or pruned. A daemon may keep building after the client is killed; no container or build closure is claimed.
stages.name: one local-path runtime image build
retained_after_failure: host input root {colima_input_dir} and any partial or verified OCI layout or deb in it, never removed or reused
the framed transfer stream and the reviewed input spec under the stage root

guest {guest_context}.oci and {guest_context}.debs, partial or complete, never removed by pattern
guest iidfile and any partial image or build cache in containerd, never pruned
stages.retention: per-input size and sha256 in the prefetch and spec helpers, the framed stream hash, trust transport and inner streams per step, the guest input receipts, nerdctl build --help, iidfile, inspect JSON, image ID

stages.closure: a positive close needs, in order: the disposable check's authenticated helper envelope closed with a waited exit 0 and the facts it prints checked; the cidfile read through the guest helper as one full container ID; and the full ID listing of all containers, read through the guest helper, not carrying that ID. The run uses --rm and its own cidfile; nerdctl removes the container before run returns, and removal failure is only logged, so removal is claimed only by the exact-ID absence. The check's guest deadline is 200 seconds (timeout -k 5) inside a 240 second host envelope. A local ssh exit alone closes nothing. Stage steps total 290 seconds inside the 300 second budget after the reserve.
stages.failure: no retry; a nonzero exit, a deadline, a broken envelope or an unknown closure stops later effects and retains the cidfile and any container; nothing is removed by name or pattern.
